name: Meta Ad Library
summary: Search the public Meta Ad Library: ads running on Facebook, Instagram and other Meta apps by keyword or page, including political and issue ads.

api_version.description: Graph API version used for ads_archive.

token.description: a Meta access token for an app whose developer has been identity-verified for the Ad Library API (https://www.facebook.com/ID)

notes: Public data, not your own account: any ad in the library, subject to Meta's coverage.
Ads outside the EU are only returned when they concern social issues, elections or politics; commercial ads are searchable for the EU and UK.
Keywords are not translated: write search_terms in the ads' language.
Error 190 is an invalid token, 613 a rate limit.

endpoints.name: Search the Meta Ad Library
endpoints.summary: Ads by keyword or Page, filtered by country, status, date, platform and media type.

ad_reached_countries.description: ISO country codes the ad reached, or ALL.

search_terms.description: Keywords, up to 100 characters. Spaces act as AND.

search_page_ids.description: Facebook Page ids to search, up to 10.

ad_delivery_date_min.description: YYYY-MM-DD; ads delivered on or after.

ad_delivery_date_max.description: YYYY-MM-DD; ads delivered on or before.

publisher_platforms.description: FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, AUDIENCE_NETWORK, MESSENGER, WHATSAPP, OCULUS, THREADS, STREAMING_SERVICES.

bylines.description: Full 'paid for by' disclaimers. Political ads only.

unmask_removed_content.description: Include content removed for policy violations.

notes: Pass fields explicitly: the answer carries only the ids unless you name the fields you want.
An empty data array on a later page means the results are exhausted.
Spend and impressions are ranges, and only available for political and issue ads and for EU-served ads.
